source_path = "data/sales_q3.csv"
output_path = "output/won_deals_q3.csv"
target_ids = {"D001", "D003", "D006", "D009"}

def parse_csv_line(line):
    fields = []
    field = ""
    quoted = False
    index = 0

    while index < len(line):
        char = line[index]

        if char == '"':
            if quoted and index + 1 < len(line) and line[index + 1] == '"':
                field += '"'
                index += 1
            else:
                quoted = not quoted
        elif char == "," and not quoted:
            fields.append(field)
            field = ""
        else:
            field += char

        index += 1

    fields.append(field.rstrip("\r\n"))
    return fields

def encode_csv_field(value):
    text = str(value)
    if any(char in text for char in [",", '"', "\r", "\n"]):
        return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return text

with open(source_path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as source:
    lines = source.readlines()

headers = parse_csv_line(lines[0])
normalized = [header.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_") for header in headers]

id_index = normalized.index("deal_id")
amount_index = normalized.index("amount")
status_index = normalized.index("status")

matches = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    if not line.strip():
        continue

    fields = parse_csv_line(line)
    deal_id = fields[id_index].strip()
    status = fields[status_index].strip().lower()

    if deal_id in target_ids and status == "won":
        matches.append((deal_id, fields[amount_index]))

with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
    output.write("deal_id,amount\n")
    for deal_id, amount in matches:
        output.write(
            encode_csv_field(deal_id) + "," +
            encode_csv_field(amount) + "\n"
        )

found_ids = {deal_id for deal_id, amount in matches}
print("Saved", len(matches), "deals to", output_path)
print("Missing or not won:", sorted(target_ids - found_ids))
